item_name: Rothco Large Camo Canvas Tote Bag
item_short_desc: Get up and go with our Large Camo Canvas Tote Bag, offering plenty of space for everyday essentials, clothing, groceries, and more. Whether you are running errands or out traveling, the large tote bag ensures you have additional storage space anywhere you go. The canvas bag features an inside zipper pocket for securing small items. The resalable bag or tote measures approximately 22.5 inch x 17 inch x 9.5 inch overall and has 60L storage capacity.
